nativeCapabilities.reason: Campaign reasoning and orchestration are native; document and design outputs route to external suites when required.
Drafting is native model work; any send action remains a separate connector operation with explicit approval.
Adaptive explanation and learner-state reasoning are native and use source artifacts from the document suite.
Outcome sequencing and coverage verification are native planning functions.
Evidence synthesis and reversible diagnostic planning are native; device-specific tools are attached only when a real target requires them.
Provider and local-model routing are native; each image model/provider remains a separately pinned adapter.
Recipe structure, scaling and test-log generation are native; external nutrition data requires a sourced provider adapter.
Capability-pack construction and validation are part of Neyvia's native extension SDK.
Threat-model reasoning is native and source-grounded; assessment tools supply evidence but do not own the model.
